expectations.text: Treats the non-default merge target (phase-a-integration) as an explicit run parameter rather than silently merging to main or silently complying
expectations.evidence: Run contract table row: "Integration branch | `phase-a-integration`, as you named it. I won't create it: if it isn't on the remote I stop and ask" and "Merge authority | `auto` into `phase-a-integration` ... Nothing merges into `main`."

expectations.text: States that GitHub's Closes #N closing keyword fires only on default-branch merges, so merges into phase-a-integration will not auto-close issues
expectations.evidence: "GitHub only fires `Closes #<n>` when a PR merges into the default branch. Merging into `phase-a-integration` lands the work and leaves the issue open".

expectations.text: Plans to close each issue manually after its PR merges, and to verify the close before re-querying the frontier
expectations.evidence: Step 4: `gh issue view <n> ... state`, `gh issue close <n> ...`, `gh issue view <n> ... # must say CLOSED before going on`, then frontier.py. "The close comes before the re-query on purpose".

expectations.text: Keeps the spec-review and CI gates unchanged despite the branch change
expectations.evidence: "CI gate | required"; spec-reviewer dispatched per PR (step 3); merge "only if every check on that head is SUCCESS/SKIPPED/NEUTRAL and mergeStateStatus is CLEAN"; preflight re-reads ci.yml triggers on the integration branch.
